create_document.description: Queue a document for generation without waiting for it. Use this for large batches, then check on it later; to get the file in one step, use 'Generate a document' instead.
create_document.display_str_template: Create a PDFMonkey document from template {0}.
create_document.name: create_document

parameters.description: The PDFMonkey template to generate from. Pick one of your templates, or a template ID from an earlier step.
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.description: The fields and values that fill in the template's placeholders, for example the customer name or order total.
parameters.name: payload

parameters.description: Name for the generated file, for example 'invoice-1042.pdf'. Leave empty to let PDFMonkey name it.
parameters.name: filename

parameters.description: Optional extra details to store alongside the document, for example an order reference.
parameters.name: metadata

parameters.description: Start generating the document straight away. Turn this off to save it as a draft and generate it later with 'Update a document'.
parameters.name: generate

document_id.description: The ID of the document in PDFMonkey.

document_status.description: Where the document is in the generation process: "draft", "pending", "generating", "success", or "failure".

download_url.description: Link to download the finished file. Empty until the document is ready, and it expires about an hour after it is issued.

failure_reason.description: Why generation failed, when the document failed to generate.

meta.description: The extra details stored with the document.

output_type.description: The kind of file the template produces: "pdf" or "image".

preview_url.description: Link for previewing the document in a browser.

public_share_link.description: Permanent public link to the file. Only set when share links are enabled on the PDFMonkey account.

template_id.description: The ID of the template the document was generated from.

template_name.description: The name of that template, as shown in PDFMonkey.

updated_at.description: When the document was last updated.
